questions.explanation: 'Have to' expresses obligation. With you, use 'have'.

wrongReasons.has: 'has' is used with he, she and it.

questions.text: You ___ to wear a uniform at this school. It's a rule.

questions.explanation: 'Used to' + base verb talks about past habits that have finished.

wrongReasons.at: 'used at' is not a correct structure here.

questions.text: I used ___ play football when I was young.
